name: Ben
overview: Ben is a male member of the tribe of Levi, noted in Scripture as a Levite who held the second rank among the Levites and served as a gatekeeper. His role is specifically mentioned in 1 Chronicles 15:18, highlighting his position within the Levitical order. Beyond these details, no additional notes are provided about his life or ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Ben' appears as a proper name in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin indicated. The biblical record simply identifies him by this name in 1 Chronicles 15:18.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Ben as a descendant of Levi, placing him within the Levitical lineage. No other familial relationships are recorded beyond this tribal affiliation.
scriptureSignificance: Ben's significance lies in his appointed service among the Levites, particularly as a gatekeeper of second rank, which implies a trusted role in the worship and temple operations. His mention in 1 Chronicles 15:18 situates him within the organized Levitical structure essential for maintaining the sanctity and order of Israel's worship practices. Though not extensively detailed, his role contributes to the broader biblical theme of dedicated service to God within the Levitical tribe.
